source_context_translations.translation: The Way that can be spoken is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
Without name, it is the beginning of heaven and earth; with name, it is the mother of the myriad things.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical road, track, or route for travel.
Sentence Translations (English): There is a road in the valley.
A broad road lies ahead.
Follow this path and go.
The cart entered by this road.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): A way of doing something, a method, procedure, or course of action.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Abstract practical sense, not the cosmic principle.
Sentence Translations (English): There is a method for ruling a state.
There is a procedure for besieging a city.
In learning, one values grasping the proper method.
The army lost its course of action.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To utter words, state something, or speak aloud.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Verbal sense of speaking or stating, not naming.
Sentence Translations (English): You do not wish to speak of it.
He then stated the matter plainly.
Everyone vied to speak of it.
I shall not speak of it again now.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental way or principle that underlies and orders reality; in this text, the ultimate, indefinable Way rather than a human road or method.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Refers to the highest, ineffable principle, not a spoken doctrine or practical procedure.
contextual_sense.Register (English): received Laozi text; early Classical Chinese philosophical usage

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Fit to be so treated; satisfactory, proper, or acceptable in a judgmental sense.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Evaluative sense, often in judgment or recommendation.
Sentence Translations (English): This proposal is indeed acceptable.
That plan is quite suitable.
This person is fairly fit for the task.
This statement may also be followed.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To regard something as acceptable and give approval or assent to it.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): A volitional act of approval or permission.
Sentence Translations (English): The ruler approved his petition.
The crowd all assented to it.
The father then approved the marriage.
The lord did not approve this proposal.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): Indicates capability, possibility, or permission: something can be done or is feasible.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Marks ability or possibility, not approval or worth.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Not right, erroneous, or contrary to what is proper or true.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Evaluative sense of being mistaken or not fitting the standard.
Sentence Translations (English): This statement is indeed wrong.
What was done is greatly wrong.
That account has many errors.
This plan is wrong.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): Negates identity or predication: marks that something is not the case or does not belong to the stated category.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Plain negation of a predication, not the later adverbial sense 'exceptional'.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): The enduring, unchanging Way; a fixed and permanent way or principle.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Emphasizes permanence and regularity, not any ordinary road or method.
contextual_sense.Register (English): received Laozi text; early Classical Chinese philosophical usage

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To give something a name, to call it by a label, or to designate it verbally.
Sentence Translations (English): I wish to name it.
The people all named the mountain.
Later generations then named this place.
The king did not dare to name the matter.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): The esteem, renown, or public standing that someone or something has.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Social standing or renown, not a label.
Sentence Translations (English): His reputation is very high.
The gentleman seeks to establish his name.
Over time, his fame became known.
With thick virtue, his reputation is made manifest.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A label or designation by which something is called.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): The word as a naming label, not reputation or the act of naming.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A fixed, enduring designation that does not change.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Stresses permanence and stability in naming, not ordinary 'long-term fame'.
contextual_sense.Register (English): received Laozi text; early Classical Chinese philosophical usage

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): Philosophical or abstract absence of being; the state of not being or the absence from which things arise.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Abstract metaphysical use, not simple lack of an object.
Sentence Translations (English): Take nonbeing as the root.
The Way is generated from nonbeing.
Observe how it returns to nothingness.
The myriad things arise from nonbeing.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): Marks absence, nonpossession, or lack of something; can function as a negator or negative existential marker.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Denies presence or possession, not mere descriptive emptiness.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): The paired totality of heaven and earth, used as a binomial for the natural world or universe as a whole.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): A fixed binomial denoting the cosmos or all creation.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): A third-person pronoun referring back to a person or thing already mentioned or understood from context.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Refers anaphorically to a previously mentioned referent.
Sentence Translations (English): Seeing the man, I respected him.
I have obtained it.
Knowing its difficulty, one does not lose it.
If a ruler loves the people, the people will also love him.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To go toward, proceed to, or move to a place.
additional_senses.Nuance (English): A direction-of-motion verb, often in formulaic or literary usage.
Sentence Translations (English): I went there.
The cart was about to go to the outskirts.
He sent someone to Chu.
The crowd all went to the gate.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): A structural particle linking a modifier to the noun it qualifies, often marking a possessive, descriptive, or genitive relation.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Purely grammatical linker in the Laozi sentence structure.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): To commence, initiate, or set something in motion.
Sentence Translations (English): The affair has only now begun.
At dawn the king began to act.
When the army arrived, the battle then began.
We shall begin discussing it tomorrow.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): The starting point or first stage of something; its origin or inception.
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): Names the initial point of a process, not the act of beginning itself.
